## The California Closets difference

[

Explore our difference

][101]
Industry Leader

California Closets® originated the custom closet industry in 1978. Today, the Brand operates across
the United States, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean.

Practical Magic™

The alchemy of highly personalized designs, custom craftsmanship, and expert installation by our own
people defines the “Practical Magic” of the California Closets’ brand experience. What begins as
rethinking a space results in a solution that is custom-designed for lifetime value and impact.

Design Leadership

Courageous storytelling differentiates our purpose and design point of view. Through our multiple
award-winning Ideas of Order brand magazine, podcast with Jeremiah Brent, and blog, we serve our
customers with stories and conversations that explore the meaning of home and our connection to the
spaces that shape us.

Our People

All of our custom designs and installations are performed by employees — never subcontractors. With
more than 1,000 > designers and 1,000 installers across North America, their collective training is
unrivaled in the industry.

3D Technology

Using our proprietary 3D software, we will create a virtual model of your custom solution, allowing
you to see how it will look and function in your room.

Premium Materials

Our thoughtfully sourced and composed palette of fine finishes and saturated colors expresses our
design sensibility and deep commitment to exceptional quality. Developed to work in every part of
the home, each element was chosen to stand alone or layer harmoniously.

Advanced Engineering

Using screen-to-machine technology and German machinery, each California Closets® solution is cut to
order based on its unique design, and a rigorous quality inspection is conducted prior to
installation.

Seamless Communication

From initial consultation to the completed installation, our employee teams offer seamless
communication during every step of the process, meeting you where and when it works for you.

## The California Closets difference

[

Explore our difference

][101]
Industry Leader

California Closets® originated the custom closet industry in 1978. Today, the Brand operates across
the United States, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean.

Practical Magic™

The alchemy of highly personalized designs, custom craftsmanship, and expert installation by our own
people defines the “Practical Magic” of the California Closets’ brand experience. What begins as
rethinking a space results in a solution that is custom-designed for lifetime value and impact.

Design Leadership

Courageous storytelling differentiates our purpose and design point of view. Through our multiple
award-winning Ideas of Order brand magazine, podcast with Jeremiah Brent, and blog, we serve our
customers with stories and conversations that explore the meaning of home and our connection to the
spaces that shape us.

Our People

All of our custom designs and installations are performed by employees — never subcontractors. With
more than 1,000 > designers and 1,000 installers across North America, their collective training is
unrivaled in the industry.

3D Technology

Using our proprietary 3D software, we will create a virtual model of your custom solution, allowing
you to see how it will look and function in your room.

Premium Materials

Our thoughtfully sourced and composed palette of fine finishes and saturated colors expresses our
design sensibility and deep commitment to exceptional quality. Developed to work in every part of
the home, each element was chosen to stand alone or layer harmoniously.

Advanced Engineering

Using screen-to-machine technology and German machinery, each California Closets® solution is cut to
order based on its unique design, and a rigorous quality inspection is conducted prior to
installation.

Seamless Communication

From initial consultation to the completed installation, our employee teams offer seamless
communication during every step of the process, meeting you where and when it works for you.

# Organisera ditt hem med förvaring från Elfa

70 års erfarenhet av smart förvaring somgör det enkelt att organisera hemmet och ge mer plats för
livet. 

Sedan1948 har vi hjälpt människor att ta vara på varje kvadratmeter – från små, utmanande utrymmen
till stora familjehem. I våra fabriker i Västervik och Mullsjö förädlar vi vår kunskap till hållbara
system där kvaliteten sitter i detaljerna, utvecklade för att anpassas efter dina behov – idag och
över tid.

# Organisera ditt hem med förvaring från Elfa

70 års erfarenhet av smart förvaring somgör det enkelt att organisera hemmet och ge mer plats för
livet. 

Sedan1948 har vi hjälpt människor att ta vara på varje kvadratmeter – från små, utmanande utrymmen
till stora familjehem. I våra fabriker i Västervik och Mullsjö förädlar vi vår kunskap till hållbara
system där kvaliteten sitter i detaljerna, utvecklade för att anpassas efter dina behov – idag och
över tid.

## Varför Elfa är experter på förvaring

Det finns många anledningar. Här är några av dem.
[

### Kvalitet

Den dagliga användningen av din Elfa förvaringslösning kräver både hantverk och material av högsta
kvalitet, för att produkterna ska hålla en livslängd. Elfa ger 10 års garanti.

Kvalitet

### Hållbarhet

bara tomma ord. Vi agerar.

ABOUT Broadjoy
Global Manufacturer Committed to Storage Hardware

Broadjoy, a name derived from the words Broad and Joy, embodies our brand philosophy: we embrace a
far-reaching global vision and a diverse product range, striving to create shared value and achieve
win-win outcomes through pleasant collaboration with partners across the globe. As a modern Chinese
enterprise integrating research and development, production, sales and service, Broadjoy has always
stayed true to this founding mission, focusing squarely on the storage hardware sector.



We specialize in three core product categories: cabinet hardware, wardrobe hardware and household
storage hardware. Our extensive range, featuring over 500 product variants, includes stainless steel
kitchen cabinet pull out baskets, lift baskets, corner baskets, clothes hanger, trouser rack,
storage basket, kitchen trash bin and so on, catering to diverse market demands such as full home
customization, wholesale and retail.

### Product overview

and families looking to maximize their kitchen space while keeping canned goods organized. With its
ability to hold up to 36 cans, this freestanding rack is ideal for those who frequently use canned
items in their cooking and want easy access to them. Made from durable chrome steel, it offers a
sturdy construction that can withstand the weight of heavy cans, making it a reliable addition to
any kitchen, pantry, or cabinet.

### Advantages over alternatives

Space-saving design: Maximizes kitchen space by holding up to 36 cans in a compact 3-tier structure.

Durable construction: Made from high-quality steel with a chrome finish, ensuring long-lasting use
without warping under heavy loads.

Easy access: The open front design allows for quick and convenient access to canned goods, keeping
your kitchen organized.

Versatile placement: Fits comfortably on countertops or inside cabinets, making it suitable for
various kitchen layouts and storage needs.

Compact dimensions: Designed to fit in tight spaces, measuring only 14.50" x 11.50" x 11.00",
perfect for small kitchens or pantries.

### Additional context

Typical use cases for this can organizer include placing it on kitchen countertops, inside cabinets,
or in pantry spaces where organization is essential. Buyers should consider the dimensions of the
product, which measures 14.50" x 11.50" x 11.00", to ensure it fits comfortably in their intended
space. Additionally, it is advisable to compare similar products in terms of capacity, material
quality, and design features to find the best fit for their storage needs. The open front design not
only enhances accessibility but also helps prevent cans from toppling over, making it a functional
choice for maintaining an orderly kitchen environment.

### WESTBOOKS

Western Australia's only full service library supplier - serving WA Libraries since 1973.

[LEARN MORE][17]
[Books]

### COLLECTION DEVELOPMENT

Westbooks offers profiled selection services, standing orders and comprehensive monthly
recommendations. Our acquisitions team will source the resources your library needs.

[LEARN MORE][18]
[Shop]

### SHELF READY

With cataloguing and processing services plus fast delivery, Westbooks will deliver titles shelf
ready at the same time as they appear in local bookstores.

[LEARN MORE][19]
[Shop]

### SCHOOL SERVICES

Westbooks is the only WA school supplier to offer a full range of shelf ready services plus
specialist advice on resources for your library or classroom.

[LEARN MORE][20]

Welcome to Westbooks, your local Western Australian library supplier. For over 40 years, we have
been providing quality reading resources and shelf ready services to State and Public libraries,
government institutions and schools.

### LIBRARIES

Westbooks specialises in WA libraries and will provide a tailored, up to date range of titles to
suit. Whether it is shelf ready services, profiled selection, standing orders or a comprehensive
review of your existing collection, we are committed to helping you regardless of your budget.

[LEARN MORE][21]

### SCHOOLS

Westbooks began as a children’s book supplier so we know all about books for children and young
adults. With dedicated sales consultants, Westbooks offers a complete range of services for schools
and is the only WA school supplier to offer shelf ready services. Let us help your school select the
right resources for your students.

[LEARN MORE][22]

### WA LOCAL

Westbooks is located in WA and no other supplier can compete with our fast delivery times to WA
libraries. We supply new release titles at the same time as they appear in local book stores. Our
consultants are available in WA business hours and can conveniently visit you on-site.

[LEARN MORE][23]

### Why Choose Westbooks?

Westbooks is Western Australia’s only full service library supplier. Being local means we can
provide you with more personalised service and the fastest turnaround time. We believe that no other
library supplier can compete with our delivery times. You owe it to your readers to have new release
titles on your library’s shelves at the same time as they appear in local bookstores.
* Fast delivery
* No minimum orders
* No lock-in contracts
* Competitive prices
* Free metro delivery
* WA local

We offer solutions for maintaining and improving your collections including selection advice,
profiling and standing orders. Our specialists in adult and children’s literature are happy to
discuss your requirements. We can assist with foundation libraries, update and refresh your current
collection as well as organise author events.

[WA books]

#### Contact Us Today

With no lock in-contracts, why not experience the Westbooks difference today?

[CONTACT US][24]

08 9361 4211

1/94 President Street, Welshpool WA 6106
Office Hours: Monday - Friday 8:30am to 4:30pm
Closed Public Holidays
+618 9361 4211
